WITH RECURSIVE
date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_daily AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dr.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
store_daily AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dr.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
web_cume AS (
    SELECT wd.item_sk,
           wd.d_date,
           wd.daily_sales AS cume_sales
    FROM web_daily wd
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_daily wd2
        WHERE wd2.item_sk = wd.item_sk
          AND wd2.d_date < wd.d_date
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wd.item_sk,
           wd.d_date,
           CASE
               WHEN wc.cume_sales IS NULL THEN wd.daily_sales
               WHEN wd.daily_sales IS NULL THEN wc.cume_sales
               ELSE wc.cume_sales + wd.daily_sales
           END AS cume_sales
    FROM web_cume wc
    JOIN web_daily wd
      ON wd.item_sk = wc.item_sk
     AND wd.d_date > wc.d_date
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_daily wd3
        WHERE wd3.item_sk = wc.item_sk
          AND wd3.d_date > wc.d_date
          AND wd3.d_date < wd.d_date
    )
),
store_cume AS (
    SELECT sd.item_sk,
           sd.d_date,
           sd.daily_sales AS cume_sales
    FROM store_daily sd
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_daily sd2
        WHERE sd2.item_sk = sd.item_sk
          AND sd2.d_date < sd.d_date
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sd.item_sk,
           sd.d_date,
           CASE
               WHEN sc.cume_sales IS NULL THEN sd.daily_sales
               WHEN sd.daily_sales IS NULL THEN sc.cume_sales
               ELSE sc.cume_sales + sd.daily_sales
           END AS cume_sales
    FROM store_cume sc
    JOIN store_daily sd
      ON sd.item_sk = sc.item_sk
     AND sd.d_date > sc.d_date
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_daily sd3
        WHERE sd3.item_sk = sc.item_sk
          AND sd3.d_date > sc.d_date
          AND sd3.d_date < sd.d_date
    )
),
x AS (
    SELECT CASE
               WHEN w.item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN w.item_sk
               ELSE s.item_sk
           END AS item_sk,
           CASE
               WHEN w.d_date IS NOT NULL THEN w.d_date
               ELSE s.d_date
           END AS d_date,
           w.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           s.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_cume w
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_cume s
      ON w.item_sk = s.item_sk
     AND w.d_date = s.d_date
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       web_sales,
       store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           web_sales,
           store_sales,
           MAX(web_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(store_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM x
) AS y
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
